questions.problem:
Find the antiderivative of
$-3x^{3}-\frac{4}{x^{6}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{x^{6}}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

Find the antiderivative of
$-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}+\frac{1}{x^{5}}+3x^{7}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

Find the antiderivative of
$\frac{6}{x^{2}}+6x^{3}+4\sqrt[3]{x^{2}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

Find the antiderivative of
$2x^{5}+\frac{1}{x^{4}}-\frac{6}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.

Find the antiderivative of
$\frac{5}{\sqrt[7]{x^{8}}}-\frac{4}{x^{2}}+4x^{4}.$ For real $x\ne 0$.
